0x00080D.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x00083F.en: 「With my skills as they are now...@　this is the end...!」

0x0008B0.en: 「Guh!@　This is as far as I go...!!」

0x000938.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B62.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B9D.en: 「I won't screw up here of all places...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BF1.en: 「Botched it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C65.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000CDB.en: 「This is as far as I go......!」

0x000D42.en: 「This is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DEE.en: 「No good, took too many hits...... I'm retreating!」

0x000E3B.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E79.en: 「Kyaah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EC0.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F6B.en: 「Ngh...... So I become a shooting star...... I'm ejecting!」

0x001022.en: 「Ow, ow, ow...... I'm beaten. Guess I miscalculated.」

0x001063.en: 「Well shoot, I done got myself beat!」

0x001114.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00115B.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001190.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00127C.en: 「Taken down in a place like this...@ How green of me...!」

0x0012CA.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001385.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0013B4.en: 「Oh no! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013F2.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001421.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x001612.en: 「I'm ejecting, I am...@ Ngh...! Not my finest hour...」

0x0016D0.en: 「Kwaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001810.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x00183F.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0018A0.en: 「A-all hands!@　Make abandoning ship top priority...!!」

0x001914.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001977.en: 「...We managed to shoot down our pursuers.」

0x0019B8.en: 「My thanks.@ Thanks to you, we made it out of the Antarctic Circle.」

0x001A05.en: 「Also, we got word from the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ If all goes well, they should be able to@ rendezvous with us in about 30 minutes.」

0x001AC0.en: (Only the Hagane and Hiryu Kai could pull that off.)

0x001AFA.en: 「Cliff, what about Fabula Foris...@ my father and the others? What happened to them?」

0x001B65.en: 「Still no contact. We have no idea@ what's going on inside that black cloud.」

0x001BE9.en: 「Those monsters came from the underground ruins, no doubt.@ Tell me what you know.」

0x001C57.en: 「Yeah...@ Given how things are, I can't very well call it classified anymore.」

0x001CB0.en: 「Fabula Foris is Latin.@ It means 'the Gate of Truth.'」

0x001D21.en: 「From our research so far, Professor Radcliff...@ Joshua and Lim's father, that is... he theorized@ it was a gate connecting to another world.」

0x001DF1.en: 「After all we've been through with the Einst and the Shura,@ that's hardly surprising.」

0x001E5C.en: 「So what kind of world is Fabula Foris@ connected to?」

0x001EC4.en: 「The details are unknown.@ The gate had always stayed shut.」

0x001F32.en: 「And the tools meant to investigate it@ were the Sympatia and the Res Arcana.」

0x001FAF.en: 「How were those two supposed to investigate...?」

0x001FE6.en: 「Professor Radcliff theorized the Sympatia,@ which can link with the human mind, was a device@ for seeing the other side of the gate...」

0x00208B.en: 「...or perhaps the key to opening it.」

0x00210F.en: 「It was believed to power devices tied to Fabula Foris... but now that I think about it, maybe how we're using it is the right way after all.」

0x0021DC.en: 「You mean as a mobile weapon's power source?」

0x002223.en: 「Then my father built the Aile Chevalier not to@ pitch it to sponsors, but to fight whatever@ comes out of Fabula Foris...?」

0x0022E9.en: 「All I was told is that it was insurance.」

0x002323.en: 「Could it be my father foresaw this...?@ If so, why did he keep it from me...!」

0x0023A0.en: 「...Probably because he wasn't certain.@ If the odds had been high, he'd have@ taken some other measure instead.」

0x002443.en: 「Joshua...@ you said earlier you could hear voices.@ What did you mean by that?」

0x0024D0.en: 「They were speaking. The Ruina...@ those who bring humans fear and despair,@ and lead them to ruin.」

0x002557.en: 「Ruina...@ Latin for 'ruin,' or 'death.'@ So do they have intelligence, and understand our language?」

0x002608.en: 「But the only ones who heard their voices were me and...」

0x002664.en: 「If it's only Joshua and Lim who heard@ their voices... then maybe the Sympatia@ has something to do with it.」

0x002703.en: 「Th-this reading... could it be the Ruina!?」

0x0027CE.en: 「You can't.@ There's no need for you to pilot the Blanche Neige anymore.」

0x002827.en: 「This is no time to say that!@ There are Li-Tech people@ aboard this transport!」

0x0028C7.en: 「It's so we all survive!@ Otherwise we can't save Father and the others!@ I'm launching, and that's final!」

0x00295E.en: 「Joshua, I'll monitor the Blanche Neige's@ systems. If anything happens, I'll report it.」

0x002A5F.en: 「Joshua, you and I will hold them off.@ We'll put Lim on transport escort.」

0x002AD3.en: 「Understood.@ ...Thank you for looking out for me.」

0x002B2F.en: 「Save the thanks for later.@ Until the Steel Dragon Squadron arrives, no matter what...」

0x002B8E.en: 「A group of objects, likely Ruina, closing from the rear!@ There's a lot of them!」

0x002C8E.en: 「...Deceleration complete, break field released.@ We made it in time, Captain.」

0x002CF6.en: 「Yes. We were fortunate to secure a high-speed@ course via formation breakout.」

0x002D7F.en: 「Well, it's tricky even in space... but the@ Pacific was closed to civilian traffic for the@ emergency, and our people cleared the way too.」

0x002E54.en: 「The Hagane and Hiryu Kai...@ to think they'd come this soon!」

0x002EAD.en: 「Only ships with the <Tesla Drive> could manage that.」

0x002EEC.en: 「Transport, to our rear!@ All units, sortie in sequence!」

0x002F36.en: 「Hugo, Joshua, fresh enemies are closing in!@ You two fall back here for now!」

0x002FC7.en: 「Unknown group, closing fast!@ They're pushing in to Range 2!」

0x00305A.en: 「Not much time has passed since you joined up@ with our team. Are you sure you're all right?」

0x0030CB.en: 「Yes. This is no time to be holding back@ our forces.」

0x003146.en: 「A lot of these are a different type than before...!」

0x003180.en: 「Not organic, but mechanical weapons.@ So there are ones like that too.」

0x0031D3.en: 「Not Einst, but something closer@ to the Aerogaters...?」

0x00323F.en: 「Drawn here by a strong pneuma... I see.@ So the one Umbra spoke of is here as well.」

0x0032BF.en: 「B-bro, I hear voices again...!@ Different from the ones at the Antarctic...!」

0x00335E.en: 「You too, huh.@ Ngh, what the hell is going on...!?」

0x0033B4.en: (I hear voices again...@ Different from the ones at the Antarctic, but...!)

0x00340A.en: (And the Sympatia's acting up too...@ Ngh, what the hell is going on...!?)

0x00348D.en: (R-Riana... I hear voices again...!@ They seem different from the ones at the Antarctic...)

0x003504.en: (And the Sympatia's acting strange too...@ What's wrong with this thing...!?)

0x00358B.en: 「Ensign Hugo, are those the ones from the Antarctic?」

0x0035D1.en: 「Yes.@ According to Joshua, they called themselves Ruina.」

0x00362A.en: 「So does that mean the ones piloting them are human?」

0x003673.en: 「Unknown.@ We saw something like human figures in the Antarctic,@ but whether they're human...」

0x0036F1.en: 「More to the point,@ where in the Antarctic were creatures like that hiding?」

0x003764.en: 「Captain, incoming comm from the unknown ahead!」

0x0037C0.en: 「No, it's an omnidirectional broadcast on a standard frequency!」

0x003828.en: (! This time I hear the voice normally...!)

0x0038BB.en: 「My, what an unexpected pairing.@ The machine's fairly sleek, though.」

0x003923.en: 「Looks aside,@ we can apparently communicate with them...」

0x00397C.en: 「Whether we can understand what he's saying@ is another matter.」

0x0039D5.en: 「Humans, gain new knowledge.@ We are those who bear 'ruin' as our name,@ who grant despair to all... and, in the end, destruction.」

0x003A83.en: 「So you're gonna crush us. Nice and clear from the get-go.@ That makes it easy!」

0x003AEE.en: 「Spare you...? Hmph, interesting.@　You look upon my form without fear,@　and even dare to speak such words.」

0x003B6F.en: 「Don't get so cocky, baldy!@　Or did you shave that dome yourself!?」

0x003C42.en: 「That's Lieutenant Katina for you, I guess.」

0x003C85.en: 「Hey, baldy!@　If you've got a name, then say it!」

0x003CDE.en: 「I am of the Melior Esse...@　Aquila, one who commands the armies of ruin.」

0x003D7A.en: 「So you're not the only commander, then.」

0x003DB7.en: 「Correct.@　The "King of Ruin" gave rise to five Melior Esse,@　each granted power and a vessel to hold it.」

0x003E57.en: (That sounds@　just like me, Tis, and Laria...)

0x003EAA.en: 「The "King of Ruin"... so that's the big boss!」

0x003EF0.en: 「We are the Ruina... the world will be drowned@　in despair by the Milites our Melior Esse command,@　and within it, you will all perish.」

0x003FA1.en: 「Ruin at the end of despair, is it?@　Whether you can deliver it, ask of my blade.」

0x004015.en: 「That will, the thing men take as fuel for their strength...@　the thing men lean upon.@　Then show me your power.」

0x0040A5.en: 「You don't have to tell me twice!」

0x0040CA.en: 「Elehb 1 to all units! Begin the attack!」

0x00410A.en: 「...I see, power befitting a strong will.@　Not so easily painted over with fear or despair.」

0x00418A.en: 「But if you hate us, if you come to fear us...@　that emotion, that negative wave,@　will make fine fuel indeed.」

0x00421D.en: 「Fuel...? What do you mean?@　And what is this "King of Ruin"!?」

0x00427F.en: 「There's no need to end this here...@　Better that we meet you in stages, step by step.」

0x0042F9.en: 「Talk is cheap for a sore loser!」

0x004327.en: 「I am Aquila of the Melior Esse.@　Carve this name into your heart with your hatred.@　...Farewell.」

0x0043E3.en: 「No, track him with the Satellite Seekers for now.@　Hold altitude, maintain TD hover. Recall all units,@　begin emergency repairs and rearm.」

0x0044B3.en: (Damn it, an enemy like that showing up...@　Is this the result of what my old man@　and the others were doing...!?)

0x004543.en: 「Ngh!@　What is this... this prickling on the back of my neck!?」

0x004596.en: 「Static in my head...@　But against the likes of you, an anomaly this minor@　is no concern at all.」

0x004617.en: 「That voice again...!@　It's not the comms. Is this coming@　through Sympatia!?」

0x00469B.en: 「Mm, this voice... I see, so it's you.」

0x0046DB.en: 「If you can hear me, answer!@　What happened to my father and the others!?」

0x004734.en: 「I know nothing.@　But that land of ice has already fallen into our hands, the Ruina's.」

0x004796.en: 「Are you telling me it's already too late!?」

0x0047CA.en: 「The closer I get to that guy,@　the more Sympatia acts up!」

0x004866.en: 「This static... I see. So that's it.」

0x004911.en: 「Human... you are different.@　That machine, too, is unlike the others... its waves overlap.@　Fascinating...!」

0x00499B.en: 「MP data attuned to enemies like that...!」

0x0049E1.en: 「Fear outweighs your fighting spirit now.@　A good sign.」

0x004A34.en: 「Sorry to disappoint, but I'm the one piloting this thing!」

0x004A7A.en: 「Mm... I sense no waves from this one.@　Is it not human?」

0x004AD3.en: 「What makes a person a person... can you even grasp it?」

0x004B16.en: 「Our will and our power! Take them upon yourself!」

0x004B56.en: 「A tenacious will...@　When it's painted over with despair, it will make@　the finest fuel of all for us!」

0x004BD7.en: 「So it's not just about beating us,@　but driving us to despair that has meaning to you!」

0x004C42.en: 「Correct... show me your power and will.@　What we seek lies beyond that.」

0x004CAA.en: 「Don't go thinking I'll get scared@　that easily!」

0x004D00.en: 「But you will all fall into the abyss of despair...@　very soon now.」

0x004D5C.en: 「Shut your mouth, baldy!@　You'll drop into hell before that ever happens!」

0x004DB8.en: 「Melior Esse, the "King of Ruin"...@　We've got fragments of intel on the Ruina now.」

0x004E2F.en: 「Yes. Unlike the Inspectors or the Guests,@　they don't seem to be after conquest.」

0x004EAF.en: 「That Aquila said the word "ruin"@　over and over...@　Could that itself be the goal?」

0x004F36.en: 「If so, they'd strike now, while we're off balance,@　with their most effective move.」

0x004FAA.en: 「Yeah... if it were me, I'd drop a bomb big enough@　to blow up the whole planet in one shot.」

0x005027.en: 「You do have a way of taking things to extremes.」

0x00505B.en: 「Method aside, if they won't finish us off...@Like the old Aerogaters, they don't mean to end@it all on the first strike.」

0x005115.en: 「So the path they take to their goal@　matters to them too...@　and that's part of the goal itself.」

0x00519C.en: 「Aquila said negative waves become fuel.@　The key to this riddle is probably there too.」

0x005213.en: (The key... could that be the Aile Chevalier@　and the Blanche Neige too...?)

0x005281.en: 「Josh, Ri-Tec and the others are heading@　to the nearest Federation base by transport.」

0x005317.en: 「Yeah, there's the matter of your machines...@　and I'm worried about the Fabula Foris professors.」

0x0053B9.en: 「One of the Ri-Tec, and a man who worked on@　developing the Aile Chevalier.@　Clifford Gygax.」

0x005452.en: 「Pleased to meet you.@　Doctor Cliff... or just Cliff is fine.」

0x0054A8.en: 「Then, Doctor Cliff... Josh and Lim@　heard the Melior Esse's voice by a means@　different from ours... any thoughts on that?」

0x005568.en: 「I suspect the cause@　lies somewhere in Sympatia.」

0x0055F8.en: 「I only learned it had that property@　a moment ago, you see.」

0x005654.en: 「I'm told only Josh and Lim can operate@　the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige.@　Could the cause lie in them personally?」

0x005727.en: 「Extremely unlikely.@　Josh and Lim felt their intent solely@　through Sympatia.」

0x0057BD.en: 「And that system has a trait:@　it only responds to those who made@　first contact with it.」

0x005856.en: 「Hmm... Aya, did you feel anything@　through the <T-LINK System>?」

0x0058C9.en: 「Aquila had a strong negative will,@　but until I heard the voice directly...」

0x005950.en: 「This is only my conjecture, but@　the Melior Esse's machines may have a device@　similar to Sympatia.」

0x0059E6.en: 「That's possible.@　Fabula Foris's technology may resemble@　that of the Ruina.」

0x005A8E.en: 「So then, whoever built that Fab-whatever@　was the Ruina?」

0x005AEA.en: 「...I can't say either way, for now.」

0x005B18.en: 「Then did the Ri-Tec actually know the Ruina existed... know in advance that damned things like those would show up?」

0x005BB7.en: 「The professor foresaw it, to a degree...@but had we known they were like that, we'd have@asked our sponsor to call in Federation forces.」

0x005CA8.en: 「I can't disclose that. It's in the contract.」

0x005CE2.en: 「Does even Josh not know of it?」

0x005D22.en: 「No... it was my father who dealt@　with the sponsor directly.」

0x005D87.en: 「Doctor... this is an emergency.@　We want any scrap of intel that could be a lead.@　Tell us who the sponsor is.」

0x005E79.en: 「Without the sponsor's permission, I can't tell you.」

0x005F05.en: (Father... please be safe...@　I'll come to save you, I promise...)

0x005FD3.en: 「Lim... cheer up.@　The whole Steel Dragon Squadron is heading to the@　South Pole, so it'll turn out all right.」

0x006082.en: 「Hey, um... can I ask you something?」

0x0060CF.en: 「I was listening to the comms during the fight...@　When you're in the Blanche Neige,@　you kind of... your whole personality changes?」

0x00617D.en: (Ah, that... I noticed too.@　She was calling Josh "big bro" and all...)

0x006219.en: (Chris, just say riding the Blanche Neige@　gets you pumped up.)

0x0062EA.en: 「U-um... when I ride the Blanche Neige,@　I get all pumped up, so...」

0x006365.en: 「Oh, so that's it. Like Princess Shine.」

0x00644A.en: (Haah... come to think of it,@　blending in with this crew is rough... age-wise.)

0x006506.en: 「Commander Alteur, this is the current report@　on the incident at the South Pole.」

0x0065A3.en: 「Is the South Pole the real target?」

0x0065C8.en: 「If anything, I'd assumed the Nafud Desert...@　but this may be certain now.」

0x00664C.en: 「However, the South Pole is being covered by a barrier.@　We hear it's now impossible to get inside.」

0x0066C3.en: 「All the more reason.@　Even if we can't reach it now, the Ri-Tec machines@　may be the key.」

0x00673B.en: 「And those two machines are with the Steel Dragons.@　This too is providence... Nibhal.」

0x0067AF.en: 「One step closer to seeing our aim fulfilled.」

0x00685C.en: 「Change course, make contact with the Steel Dragons.@　Then requisition every ship and weapon they have.」

0x0068CD.en: 「! Why would we do such a thing...」

0x006901.en: 「It's come to light in our investigation:@　the Steel Dragons left Federation command,@　went missing...」

0x00698B.en: 「and during that time, are suspected@　of contact with hostile forces.」

0x0069F6.en: 「Yes, this matter has been relayed to the President.@　A rigorous inquiry has been deemed necessary.」

0x006A82.en: 「Besides, precisely because it's a crisis, specialized@　forces like theirs must be strictly controlled.」

0x006AFF.en: 「...I concur.@　But if this ship continues south, we risk@　contact with the Unknown at the South Pole.」

0x006BA4.en: 「The President should disembark, and we should@　arrange his swift transfer to a safe location.」

0x006C1B.en: 「No, he'll attend the requisition as well.@　To show our authority and bring the Steel Dragons to heel.」

0x006CD5.en: 「Have you no confidence in protecting the President?」

0x006D59.en: 「Sir.@The Gaia Sabers carrier fleet will now@change heading and make contact with the Steel Dragons.」

0x006DEA.en: (Now then... it's finally beginning.@　The Guests, the Unknown at the pole, and us...@　the more the world trembles, the better...)

0x006E89.en: (That way, this time it will surely show itself.)
